editorial: You’re pulled into a tight crawlspace where every echo feels like an accusation. The film maps ordinary suburban life onto a bleak, dimly lit basement, turning a familiar room into a psychological chessboard. What sets it apart is the soundtrack that folds the walls into a muttering presence, making silence a hazard. If you savor slow-burn thrillers that keep you on edge, this is the piece for your watchlist. A few moments in the middle drag a little, but the tension stays high.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of tense psychological thrillers who appreciate an unrelenting atmosphere.
